column1: # Book 3 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 3.493 spumans agrees with vis morbi, not animam.
# 3.539 the subject changes from locus to the spirit (dilaniata, feminine); "it" had kept the place as subject.

column2: foaming, drives and troubles the spirit, as on the salt sea
the spirit, torn apart, is scattered abroad and so perishes.
